keyEvents.text: Substitution, Brann. Kristian Eriksen replaces Thore Pedersen.
Goal! Sint-Truiden 1, Brann 0. Nelson Ishiwatari (Sint-Truiden) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner.
Substitution, Sint-Truiden. Ryan Merlen replaces Shion Shinkawa.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Brann. Sævar Magnússon replaces Niklas Castro.
Substitution, Brann. Joachim Soltvedt replaces Jonas Torsvik.
Substitution, Sint-Truiden. Arbnor Muja replaces Nathanaël Mbuku.
Arbnor Muja (Sint-Truiden) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sint-Truiden. Samed Bazdar replaces Frederic Soèllé Soèllé.
Goal! Sint-Truiden 1, Brann 1. Ulrik Mathisen (Brann) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Kristall Ingason with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Brann. Vetle Dragsnes replaces Ulrik Mathisen.
Sævar Magnússon (Brann) is shown the yellow card.
